description: This file defines a wizard interface for follow-up printing and email notifications in an OpenERP/Odoo module related to account follow-ups. It includes form definitions, methods for updating follow-up data, and sending emails to partners with unpaid invoices.

classes.name: followup_all_print
classes.description: A wizard interface class for managing follow-up printing and email notifications.

methods.name: _update_partners
methods.description: Updates follow-up lines and dates for specified partners and move lines.

methods.name: _sendmail
methods.description: Sends follow-up reminder emails to partners with unpaid invoices, generating reports and attaching them.

methods.name: _get_partners
methods.description: Retrieves partners with move lines due for follow-up based on selected follow-up lines and dates.

methods.name: _get_screen1_values
methods.description: Initializes form with current follow-up and date based on company settings.
